reasons.action: No new action or performance is requested; “swap them both” only changes identities. The edit-source clip’s hammer strike and turn-to-camera behavior remain the action.
reasons.medium: No rendering change is authorized; the medium decision preserves the live-action reference, so the medium remains reference-governed.
reasons.wardrobe: No explicit clothing change is requested. The replacement identity portraits retain their observed wardrobe as identity attributes; the clip’s wardrobe belongs to the figures being replaced.
reasons.lighting: No lighting instruction is requested. The edit-source clip’s bright natural window daylight governs; the portrait references’ studio lighting is identity-reference presentation and must not replace the clip’s world.
reasons.framing: No requested shot scale, viewpoint, or camera movement is specified. The edit-source clip’s medium-wide framing and tightening camera govern; canvas aspect alone does not set framing.
reasons.palette: No requested color grade or tonal treatment is specified. The edit-source clip’s live-action palette governs, and the portrait studio backdrops do not regrade the scene.
